facts.text: The simulator reports max_width as a constant 0.08 m, matching the real Franka Hand's 8 cm stroke
A grasp succeeds only when the stall distance d satisfies width - epsilon_inner < d < width + epsilon_outer
Neither gripper backend reads a real grip force, and the commanded force is not applied as a limit
A grasp drives the fingers fully closed and saturates the physics servo at FINGER_FORCE_LIMIT (100 N) whatever force the client asked for; force limiting is not implemented
stop() drives the fingers fully open and reuses the homing path; the real Franka Hand halts in place, so a client that stops mid-grasp sees the object released in the simulator
The kinematic backend ignores the commanded speed entirely
The physics move accepts speed for protocol compatibility but does not use it to pace the motion
The physics grasp accepts speed and force for protocol compatibility but does not use them
The reported temperature is a stub, constant 30 Cel
The shipped scene contains no graspable body, so by default every grasp closes on nothing and answers false
homing drives the fingers fully open, blocks until they settle, clears the grasp and stuck state and always reports success
move validates the width, drives the fingers and blocks until they settle or the timeout elapses, then sets is_stuck if they did not settle
get_state returns the summed width, maximum width, grasp flag and temperature from a lock-free snapshot
A width outside 0..max_width raises ValueError, which the gripper server turns into kFail
The upstream physics-hand tests call grasp with epsilon_inner 0.005 m and epsilon_outer 0.005 m
The gripper command methods block until the fingers settle or the settle timeout elapses

determinism.notes: the fake has no randomness; no seed is needed

gaps: no physics engine, no finger servo and no contact: width changes instantly and the epsilon band is applied to an in-memory stall width
the upstream physics backend infers a grasp from the finger DOFs and blocks until they settle; the fake does neither
commanded speed and force are accepted for signature compatibility and ignored, as the upstream documents for its own backends
there is no arm, scene, object body or mobile base in the fake; only the Franka Hand is served
